elements.element: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Customer
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products"

elements.element: Exclusivity confined to a defined product category
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products" (defined term); open-ended "or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar...)" removed
"during the period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date" replacing "during the term of this Agreement"

elements.element: Automatic termination of the restriction on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "shall terminate automatically upon any failure by HDI to meet any service level ... under this Agreement"

elements.element: Automatic termination of the restriction on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates

reasons: Locked target is the fallback, and all four fallback atomic elements are present in operative text: closed product category (defined "Deerskin Products"), a 12-month cap running from the Effective Date, and an automatic release on any missed service level or delivery date.
Preferred position is not met because an exclusivity covenant still binds the Company; that is acceptable given the locked fallback target.

Edits are minimal: two surgical phrase replacements (duration operator and scope carve-back) plus one concise sentence supplying the absent automatic-release mechanic; no whole-clause rewrite or boilerplate added.

Intent preserved: HDI's exclusive brand right, the Section 6.2 carve-out reference, and the unrelated Section 4.1 term/termination-payment mechanics remain effective, and no undefined term or contradiction is introduced (twelve months sits within the one-year initial term, so the cap does not dangle).
